nodes.label: SURGE Frontend UX Improvement Report
nodes.rationale: Static file-by-file analysis of web-map-next/src identifying 100+ issues across session management, error handling, accessibility, navigation and data visualization; based on source reading only, so a usability test would be needed to validate priorities.

nodes.label: C-05 Silent API Error Fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Called the most structurally damaging UX issue in the codebase: API modules catch errors and return emptyGeoJson or all-zero BOM values, so TanStack Query treats every map query as successful, isError never fires, a network failure looks like an empty project, and a BOM failure renders a $0.00 bill of materials.

nodes.label: C-07 Synthetic Elevation Profile Without Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: When route coordinates are missing the profile falls back to hardcoded coordinates and sine/cosine elevation values with no Simulated label, so engineering users can make routing decisions on fabricated terrain.

nodes.label: C-02 No URL Routing
nodes.rationale: View state lives in Zustand with no routes, so nothing is bookmarkable or shareable, back/forward do nothing, and a refresh loses the active view, project and context - which compounds C-10's lack of persistence.

nodes.label: C-11 Toast System Failures
nodes.rationale: Single-toast store, WCAG contrast failures (1.6:1 success, 3.1:1 error), no dismiss, no role=alert or aria-live, no pause on hover, and misleading green styling for 'Imported nothing' - making it unusable as the foundation for all other feedback.

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Accessibility Gaps
nodes.rationale: Missing ARIA roles and labels, absent focus-visible styling, sub-44px touch targets, colour-only state encoding and feeder colours indistinguishable under deuteranopia/protanopia recur across nav, auth, layers, admin and map.

nodes.label: Phase 1 - Trust and Reliability Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Letting API errors propagate is sequenced first because it unlocks all other error UX; the rest of Phase 1 targets confusion, data loss and trust erosion before any feature work.
